purpose: Fixture-driven cases for the normalized-event parser (plan 6.2 step 4). Complements, and does not replace, the shared transcript corpus in tests/fixtures/transcripts.

run-failed.expectation: command, exit code, and error excerpt from a failed Bash result

run-succeeded.expectation: a successful run carries no exit code because the transcript records none

tool-error-edit.expectation: a failing non-Bash tool result is a tool_error, never a run

tool-rejected.expectation: the interrupt-during-tool-use sentinel is a rejection whose next user turn is the correction

tool-rejected-permission.expectation: both permission-denial sentinels reject; a rejected Bash is not a run

interrupt-then-correction.expectation: the interrupt sentinel, the correction that follows, and a later turn that is not a correction

interrupt-assistant-resumes.expectation: once the agent completes an action the correction window is closed

file-read.expectation: two tool_use blocks on one line: file_read at the call line, run at its result line

truncated-final-line.expectation: an incomplete final line is skipped; earlier complete lines still parse

unresolved-run.expectation: a run whose result never arrives is flushed at end of file with an unknown exit

plain-turns.expectation: prose, ordinary turns, and successful non-Bash results are not events; the interrupt sentinel must match exactly
